tasks.label: Start Valkey
tasks.detail: Starts (or creates) the kindle-kreate-valkey Docker container on localhost:6379
tasks.command: docker start kindle-kreate-valkey 2>/dev/null || docker run -d --name kindle-kreate-valkey -p 6379:6379 valkey/valkey:8-alpine

windows.command: docker start kindle-kreate-valkey; if (-not $?) { docker run -d --name kindle-kreate-valkey -p 6379:6379 valkey/valkey:8-alpine }
